headline.title: Kimi: Threat or menace?
headline.summary: Moonshot AI has launched an updated version of its Kimi model, raising alarms over potential implications for "full AI communism." The release has sparked discussions about the ethical and societal impacts of advanced AI technologies.

articles.title: The apps, gadgets, and tools every reader needs
articles.summary: The article highlights essential apps, gadgets, and tools for readers, providing a curated selection aimed at enhancing the reading experience. It is part of the Installer series, which offers recommendations on various tech-related topics.

articles.title: Your Period Tracker Is (Probably) Spying on You
articles.summary: A recent report highlights privacy concerns surrounding period tracking apps, suggesting that many may collect and share sensitive user data without adequate consent. The article also discusses various cybersecurity issues, including Russian cyberspies targeting infrastructure and a breach involving an AI music generator.

articles.title: How Google’s New Gemini Rates Work and How to Track Your Usage
articles.summary: Google has updated its Gemini usage quotas, which may result in users receiving fewer AI responses than previously experienced. The article provides guidance on how to track your usage under the new rating system.

articles.title: Endogenous Alignment
articles.summary: The article discusses how adults begin to align children's behaviors with societal values around the age of one, primarily through exogenous methods such as rewards and punishments. It emphasizes the effectiveness of operant conditioning in shaping children's instinctive behaviors to encourage positive actions and discourage negative ones.

articles.title: Vertu wants executives to pay $6,880 for an AI agent — here’s how it actually performs
articles.summary: Vertu's luxury foldable smartphone, priced at $6,880, integrates an AI agent designed to enhance user workflows, battery life, and security. A detailed evaluation reveals the practical performance and daily usability of the device.

articles.title: Prompt Injection Attacks Are Thwarting AI Hacking Agents
articles.summary: Researchers have developed a technique called "context bombing" that effectively prevents malicious AI agents from executing harmful actions by tricking them into shutting down. This method addresses the growing concern of prompt injection attacks targeting AI systems.

articles.title: Databricks hits $188B valuation, extending its run as AI’s favorite second act
articles.summary: Databricks has achieved a valuation of $188 billion as it positions itself as a leader in the AI sector, focusing on the benefits of open weight AI models for coding. The company has shifted its branding to emphasize its commitment to artificial intelligence technologies.

articles.title: Should we benchmark conceptual capabilities using judgment prediction tasks?
articles.summary: The article discusses the challenges of using subjective judgment prediction tasks to benchmark AI capabilities, suggesting that such tasks may not effectively measure AI performance. It proposes a more structured approach, where AIs are explicitly instructed to predict specific individuals' judgments on complex issues, to improve the benchmarking process.

articles.title: Neil Rimer thinks the AI money is coming back out
articles.summary: Venture capitalist Neil Rimer, co-founder of Index Ventures, forecasts that the significant wealth generated by AI in Silicon Valley will need to be redistributed, either voluntarily or involuntarily. His comments highlight the ongoing economic impact of AI advancements in the tech industry.

articles.title: The Zoom hack that says, ‘Don’t record me’
articles.summary: A new Zoom feature allows users to prevent automatic recording and transcription of meetings, addressing privacy concerns about the handling of sensitive conversations. This development highlights the ongoing debate regarding data privacy and the implications of AI-driven transcription services.

articles.title: Agility Robotics plants its flag in Tesla’s backyard
articles.summary: Agility Robotics has announced the opening of a new training center for its Digit robots in Fremont, California. This location is strategically situated near Tesla's headquarters, highlighting the company's focus on advancing its robotic technology.
